text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On our way back to the academy, we run
into
Nice Nature, who invites Kitasan
Black and me to
a flea market in the
shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well? What do you think of the best
bread in the
whole shopping district?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! It's delicious! And the apricot jam
on top
takes it to a whole other level!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper A
text_block_list.text: I know, right? It should be flying off the shelves, but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Can't really sell something without
people to sell
to...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The whole market does feel deserted...
but why?
People should be flocking here
with food this
yummy on sale!
choice_data_list: Now that you mention it, foot traffic has...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I heard there's a big event being held
nearby, so
everyone must be there
instead.

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper A
text_block_list.text:
This flea market is supposed to promote
the
shopping district's upcoming
Gratitude Festival,
but at this rate, no
one will know about it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Now, now! There's no need to get so
depressed!
After all, you have two very
pleased customers
right in front of you,
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Um... If it's all right with you, I'd like to
help you
out!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, and you're going to help! Oh, but
first, let's
buy some extra bread and jam.
choice_data_list: Do you have something in mind?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Now we've gotta spread the jam
on the
bread, and...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Here, Trainer! Let's tuck in!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
We've got apricot, strawberry, kiwi, and

blueberry jam! Heap on as much as you
like!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
What do you wanna start with? How
about some
good ol' strawberry jam?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black passes me a slice of bread
slathered
with strawberry jam, so I
accept it and take a bite.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: How is it?

text_block_list.name: Passerby
text_block_list.text:
That does look really tasty... Are they
selling that
at an event nearby or
something?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
We bought them at that flea market just
over
there! They've got tons of delicious
food and
bargain finds for sale!

text_block_list.name: Passerby
text_block_list.text:
Wow, really? I had no idea they were
doing a flea
market. Maybe we should
go take a peek.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
All right! Let's keep up the good work
and try
another location!
choice_data_list: Awesome, we managed to pull in a group...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Mm-mmm! This kiwi jam bread really hits
the spot!
I can feel all the exhaustion
leaving my body!

text_block_list.name: Jogger
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I suddenly feel hungry.
choice_data_list: It's nicely tart, with a pleasant aftertaste.
It's nicely tart, with a pleasant aftertaste, too.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh, go ahead and take a slice if you
like! They're
selling them right over
there at the flea market!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Chatter, chatter... Murmur, murmur...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wh-whoa, we're getting so many
customers!
How'd you manage to pull so
many people so
quickly, Kitasan?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, all we did was have some fun!
Curiosity did
the rest.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Even when you're busy or in a rush
somewhere, if
you hear people having
fun, you naturally wanna
see what's
going on, right?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You might wonder what the ruckus is
about and
take a look. Once you do,
you've already become
part of the
festival!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
People'll inevitably get swept up in the

excitement, so all we gotta do is keep
enjoying
ourselves and keep the party
vibes high!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wow, just like that? We're clearly
learning from
the master here.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yup! But it's thanks to the shops here
that I was
able to hype things up so
much!
choice_data_list: So that's why you were fooling around outside.
So that's why you were fooling around outside, huh?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's welcoming personalities and
the care
they poured into each product
are what got the
customers so excited!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hehe! You're sure laying it on thick.

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper A
text_block_list.text:
You're right, though! The shopping
district's
relaxed and friendly
atmosphere is our main
selling point!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper B
text_block_list.text:
Once the customers are here, the rest is
up to us!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for all your help, you two. I have
a feeling
the festival is gonna be A-OK!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Here! Have some tasty bread and jam as
a
thank-you gift!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Here! Have some tasty bread and jam as
a
thank-you gift!
choice_data_list: Besides, calling in customers was fun.
Besides, calling in customers was fun, too.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Me, chic?! Hehe, that might be going a
bit too
far...
choice_data_list: Besides, calling in customers was fun.
Besides, calling in customers was fun, too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Come on, you're our super stylish
captain! Hold
your head high!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Aw, you guys! I'm gonna take that as a
sincere
compliment, then! Haha!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Dad... I wonder if I've managed to get a
tiny step
closer to being like you...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It really was! You sure know what you're
talking
about, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
And it's not like we didn't get anything
out of it
ourselves. I mean, it was so
much fun!
